title: Signal: AWS credentials file served
scope: One response whose body is an AWS shared-credentials file, identified by a profile section and an aws_access_key_id key.
limitations: One response body. The rule reports the credentials-file shape; it does not use the key and cannot determine the permissions attached to it.

observation.body:
[default]

region = us-east-1
